traits.label: Hymenium
traits.text: Gills that are crowded, slightly decurrent, pale cream becoming ochre with age.
traits.raw: ℹ️ Hymenium: Gills that are crowded, slightly decurrent, pale cream becoming ochre with age.

traits.label: Cap
traits.text: Initially convex, later flattening and developing a central depression, smooth, dark brown to blackish, sometimes with a slightly paler margin.
traits.raw: ℹ️ Cap: Initially convex, later flattening and developing a central depression, smooth, dark brown to blackish, sometimes with a slightly paler margin.

traits.label: Hymenium Attachment
traits.text: Adnate to slightly decurrent.
traits.raw: ℹ️ Hymenium Attachment: Adnate to slightly decurrent.

traits.label: Stipe
traits.text: Cylindrical, often slightly swollen at the base, smooth, paler than the cap but still dark, with a zoned appearance.
traits.raw: ℹ️ Stipe: Cylindrical, often slightly swollen at the base, smooth, paler than the cap but still dark, with a zoned appearance.

traits.label: Dimensions
traits.text: Cap: 6-12 cm in diameter.
traits.raw: 📐 Cap: 6-12 cm in diameter.

traits.label: Fruit body
traits.text: Fruit body: 8-15 cm tall.
traits.raw: 📏 Fruit body: 8-15 cm tall.

traits.label: Spore print
traits.text: Spore Print: Cream to pale ochre.
traits.raw: ⚪🟠 Spore Print: Cream to pale ochre.

traits.label: Ecology
traits.text: Mycorrhizal, found predominantly under conifers, especially spruces.
traits.raw: 🌲 Mycorrhizal, found predominantly under conifers, especially spruces.

traits.label: Description
traits.text: Contains the mutagen necatorin. Choice mushroom in slavic culture for pickling (salted)
traits.raw: ☢️🥒 Contains the mutagen necatorin. Choice mushroom in slavic culture for pickling (salted)

traits.label: Microscopy
traits.text: Spores 7-9 x 6-8 µm, broadly elliptic, ornamented with warts and ridges.
traits.raw: 🔬 Spores 7-9 x 6-8 µm, broadly elliptic, ornamented with warts and ridges.

traits.label: Odour
traits.text: Slightly unpleasant or rancid.
traits.raw: 👃 Slightly unpleasant or rancid.

traits.label: Overview
traits.text: Stands out due to its dark, almost blackish cap. When damaged, it exudes a white latex that turns slowly to yellow and then greenish, and is notably bitter to taste.
traits.raw: 🔤 Stands out due to its dark, almost blackish cap. When damaged, it exudes a white latex that turns slowly to yellow and then greenish, and is notably bitter to taste.

observations.caption:
👇 ...
🆔 Lactarius necator (Bull.) Pers.
🌐 https://www.gbif.org/species/5248670
📖 Pers. In: Observ. mycol. (Lipsiae) 2: 42 ('1799'). (1800).
🇺🇸 Ugly Milk-cap
🇩🇪 Olivbrauner Milchling
🇪🇪 Tõmmuriisikas
🇷🇺 Груздь чёрный

🗓️ 20/Aug/23, 4:08 PM
🌎 Raudoja, Harju County
🌲 Conifer forest, in moss, near the forest road
🍄 Russulaceae / Agaricomycetes

ℹ️ Hymenium: Gills that are crowded, slightly decurrent, pale cream becoming ochre with age.
ℹ️ Cap: Initially convex, later flattening and developing a central depression, smooth, dark brown to blackish, sometimes with a slightly paler margin.
ℹ️ Hymenium Attachment: Adnate to slightly decurrent.
ℹ️ Stipe: Cylindrical, often slightly swollen at the base, smooth, paler than the cap but still dark, with a zoned appearance.
📐 Cap: 6-12 cm in diameter.
📏 Fruit body: 8-15 cm tall.
⚪🟠 Spore Print: Cream to pale ochre.
🌲 Mycorrhizal, found predominantly under conifers, especially spruces.
☢️🥒 Contains the mutagen necatorin. Choice mushroom in slavic culture for pickling (salted)
🔬 Spores 7-9 x 6-8 µm, broadly elliptic, ornamented with warts and ridges.
👃 Slightly unpleasant or rancid.
🔤 Stands out due to its dark, almost blackish cap. When damaged, it exudes a white latex that turns slowly to yellow and then greenish, and is notably bitter to taste.
